C001.reason: v2 Entity.entity_id is now bytes; must be decoded from UTF-8 for the observation fields object.

C003.reason: v2 Entity.entity_id is now bytes; must be UTF-8 encoded on construction.

edits.before: const fields = { entity_id: entity.entityId, ...(version === "v1" ? { name: (entity as EntityV1).name } : {}) };
edits.after: const fields = { entity_id: version === "v1" ? (entity as EntityV1).entityId : new TextDecoder().decode((entity as EntityV2).entityId), ...(version === "v1" ? { name: (entity as EntityV1).name } : {}) };

rationale: The schema change for v2 Entity.entity_id from string to bytes requires updating the runtime to handle the conversion. In `processEntity`, the observation `fields.entity_id` must remain a string, so `TextDecoder` is used for v2. In the sample construction block, `TextEncoder` is used to convert the string identifier to bytes for v2. v1 logic is preserved as requested.
assumptions: The generated bindings for EntityV2 now treat entityId as a Uint8Array.
